info.name: Limble API V2 Assets Invoices API
Attach a file to an invoice

params.name: taskID
params.description: The taskID of the invoice you want remove the file from.

params.name: invoiceID
params.description: The invoiceID of the invoice you want to remove the file from.

items.docs: This request will attach a text or image file to an invoice on an **open** Task (i.e. task status=0).

params.name: taskID
params.description: The taskID of the invoice you want remove the file from.

params.name: invoiceID
params.description: The invoiceID of the invoice you want to remove the file from.

items.docs: This request removes a file attached to an invoice on an open Task (i.e. task status = 0).

params.name: invoices
params.description: This parameter is used to only get specific invoices or invoices. This parameter accepts a comma delimited list of invoice IDs.

params.name: tasks
params.description: This parameter is used to only get invoices on a task or tasks. This parameter accepts a comma delimited list of task IDs.

params.name: start
params.description: This parameter is used to only get invoices that were logged after the unix timestamp passed into the start parameter. For example, all Invoices that were last edited after April 18th, 2018.

params.name: end
params.description: This parameter is used to only get invoices that were logged *before* the unix timestamp passed into the end parameter.

params.name: cursor
params.description: This parameter is a cursor that selects what invoiceID you want to start receiving results at. e.g. passing 137 here will only get you tasks with an id greater than 137.

params.name: limit
params.description: This parameter is a result limiter. The default is set to return no more than 100 results at one time.

items.docs: This request gets all Invoices associated with Tasks.
